candidates.label: Quran as hakim Book providing guidance-mercy for muhsinin
candidates.definition: In 31:2-3: Verses of wise Book; guidance and mercy for doers of good who establish prayer give zakah are certain of Hereafter.

evidence.excerpt: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ

candidates.label: Idle talk (lahw al-hadith) as misguidance mechanism without knowledge
candidates.definition: In 31:6: Of people is he who purchases idle talk to mislead from way of Allah without knowledge and takes it in ridicule.

evidence.excerpt: وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يَشۡتَرِي لَهۡوَ ٱلۡحَدِيثِ لِيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَيَتَّخِذَهَا هُزُوًاۚ أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ

candidates.label: Creation without visible pillars with mountain stabilization
candidates.definition: In 31:10: Created heavens without pillars you see; cast firmly set mountains on earth lest it shake with you.

evidence.excerpt: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيۡرِ عَمَدٖ تَرَوۡنَهَاۖ وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٖۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ

candidates.label: Paired creation through rain as universal design principle
candidates.definition: In 31:10: Sent down rain from sky produced therein every noble pair.

evidence.excerpt: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ بِغَيۡرِ عَمَدٖ تَرَوۡنَهَاۖ وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَبَثَّ فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ دَآبَّةٖۚ وَأَنزَلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجٖ كَرِيمٍ

candidates.label: Luqman granted hikmah as gratitude-based wisdom
candidates.definition: In 31:12: We gave Luqman wisdom: be grateful to Allah; whoever is grateful benefits himself; Allah Ghani Hameed.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا لُقۡمَٰنَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِلَّهِۚ وَمَن يَشۡكُرۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٞ

candidates.label: Shirk as zulm azim (great injustice) — supreme moral classification
candidates.definition: In 31:13: O my son do not associate partners with Allah; indeed shirk is great injustice (zulm azim).

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذۡ قَالَ لُقۡمَٰنُ لِٱبۡنِهِۦ وَهُوَ يَعِظُهُۥ يَٰبُنَيَّ لَا تُشۡرِكۡ بِٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّ ٱلشِّرۡكَ لَظُلۡمٌ عَظِيمٞ

candidates.label: Parental kindness bounded by tawheed with continued ma'ruf companionship
candidates.definition: In 31:14-15: Enjoined goodness to parents; if they strive for shirk do not obey; accompany in world with ma'ruf.

evidence.excerpt: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ حَمَلَتۡهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهۡنًا عَلَىٰ وَهۡنٖ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ فِي عَامَيۡنِ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيۡكَ إِلَيَّ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

candidates.label: Mustard-seed accountability demonstrating divine subtlety-awareness
candidates.definition: In 31:16: O my son if there be weight of mustard seed in rock or heavens or earth Allah brings it forth; Latif Khabir.

evidence.excerpt: يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٖ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٖ فَتَكُن فِي صَخۡرَةٍ أَوۡ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَوۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَأۡتِ بِهَا ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٞ

candidates.label: Five-fold paternal counsel: salah-amr-nahy-sabr as integrated ethical program
candidates.definition: In 31:17: Establish prayer enjoin right forbid wrong endure patiently; indeed that is determined matters.

evidence.excerpt: يَٰبُنَيَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأۡمُرۡ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَٱنۡهَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عَزۡمِ ٱلۡأُمُورِ

candidates.label: Anti-arrogance commands: no cheek-turning no insolent walking
candidates.definition: In 31:18: Do not turn cheek in contempt toward people; do not walk insolently on earth; Allah loves not arrogant boastful.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا تُصَعِّرۡ خَدَّكَ لِلنَّاسِ وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخۡتَالٖ فَخُورٖ

candidates.label: Moderate pace and lowered voice as embodied humility markers
candidates.definition: In 31:19: Be moderate in pace lower voice; harshest voice is donkey's.

evidence.excerpt: وَٱقۡصِدۡ فِي مَشۡيِكَ وَٱغۡضُضۡ مِن صَوۡتِكَۚ إِنَّ أَنكَرَ ٱلۡأَصۡوَٰتِ لَصَوۡتُ ٱلۡحَمِيرِ

candidates.label: Gratitude benefiting self alone as divine self-sufficiency corollary
candidates.definition: In 31:12: Whoever is grateful benefits only himself; Allah is Ghani Hameed.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا لُقۡمَٰنَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِلَّهِۚ وَمَن يَشۡكُرۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٞ

candidates.label: Weaning at two years as developmental milestone linked to parental gratitude
candidates.definition: In 31:14: Mother bore him weakness upon weakness; his weaning is in two years.

evidence.excerpt: وَوَصَّيۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ بِوَٰلِدَيۡهِ حَمَلَتۡهُ أُمُّهُۥ وَهۡنًا عَلَىٰ وَهۡنٖ وَفِصَٰلُهُۥ فِي عَامَيۡنِ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِي وَلِوَٰلِدَيۡكَ إِلَيَّ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ

candidates.label: Sabr over affliction as determined matters (azm al-umur)
candidates.definition: In 31:17: Endure patiently over what befalls you; indeed that is of determined matters.

evidence.excerpt: يَٰبُنَيَّ أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَأۡمُرۡ بِٱلۡمَعۡرُوفِ وَٱنۡهَ عَنِ ٱلۡمُنكَرِ وَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَآ أَصَابَكَۖ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عَزۡمِ ٱلۡأُمُورِ

candidates.label: Successful ones defined as those guided by Lord's wisdom
candidates.definition: In 31:5: Those are upon guidance from their Lord and they are the successful (muflihun).

evidence.excerpt: أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدٗى مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ

candidates.label: Universal subjection of heavens-earth with apparent-hidden blessings
candidates.definition: In 31:20: Do you not see Allah subjected whatever in heavens earth and lavished blessings apparent and hidden?

evidence.excerpt: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَأَسۡبَغَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَٰهِرَةٗ وَبَاطِنَةٗۗ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِي ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَلَا هُدٗى وَلَا كِتَٰبٖ مُّنِيرٖ

candidates.label: Ancestral tradition following despite satanic misdirection
candidates.definition: In 31:21: When told follow what Allah revealed say follow what found fathers upon; even if Satan invites to Blaze?

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّبِعُواْ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ قَالُواْ بَلۡ نَتَّبِعُ مَا وَجَدۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ ءَابَآءَنَآۚ أَوَلَوۡ كَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ يَدۡعُوهُمۡ إِلَىٰ عَذَابِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ

candidates.label: Islam as face-submission producing good action and grasping firmest handhold
candidates.definition: In 31:22: Whoever submits face to Allah while doing good grasped firmest handhold (urwat al-wuthqa).

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَمَن يُسۡلِمۡ وَجۡهَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٞ فَقَدِ ٱسۡتَمۡسَكَ بِٱلۡعُرۡوَةِ ٱلۡوُثۡقَىٰۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡأُمُورِ

candidates.label: Disbeliever grief negated with return-information promise
candidates.definition: In 31:23: Whoever disbelieves let not disbelief grieve you; to Us is return; We inform them of what they did.

evidence.excerpt: وَمَن كَفَرَ فَلَا يَحۡزُنكَ كُفۡرُهُۥٓۚ إِلَيۡنَا مَرۡجِعُهُمۡ فَنُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمُۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ

candidates.label: Travel-observation methodology confirming historical destruction pattern
candidates.definition: In 31:26: Have they not traveled earth observed end of those before? Allah destroyed them.

evidence.excerpt: لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ

candidates.label: Universal ownership with Ghani-Hamid attributes
candidates.definition: In 31:26: To Allah belongs whatever in heavens earth; Allah is Ghani Hamid.

evidence.excerpt: لِلَّهِ مَا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلۡغَنِيُّ ٱلۡحَمِيدُ

candidates.label: Creation-resurrection ease comparison establishing ba'th plausibility
candidates.definition: In 31:28: Creation and resurrection of all is not but like single soul; Allah is Hearing Seeing.

evidence.excerpt: مَّا خَلۡقُكُمۡ وَلَا بَعۡثُكُمۡ إِلَّا كَنَفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٌ

candidates.label: Night-day alternation and maritime signs for patient-grateful people
candidates.definition: In 31:29,31: Allah alternates night into day day into night; ships run by His command; signs for every sabir shakur.

evidence.excerpt: أَلَمۡ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيۡلَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِي ٱلَّيۡلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ يَجۡرِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ مُّسَمّٗى وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ

candidates.label: Hour sealing mouths with hands-feet testimony as bodily accountability
candidates.definition: In 31:24: Day Hour comes seal their mouths; hands speak feet testify to what they earned.

evidence.excerpt: نُمَتِّعُهُمۡ قَلِيلٗا ثُمَّ نَضۡطَرُّهُمۡ إِلَىٰ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٖ

candidates.label: Divine guidance-misguidance sovereignty with might-wisdom attributes
candidates.definition: In 31:27: Allah guides whom He wills misguides whom He wills; He is Aziz Hakim.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَوۡ أَنَّمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقۡلَٰمٞ وَٱلۡبَحۡرُ يَمُدُّهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡحُرٖ مَّا نَفِدَتۡ كَلِمَٰتُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ

candidates.label: Human pairing-progeny-affinity system as social creation design
candidates.definition: In 31:28: Created you from single soul made mate produced offspring and affinity.

evidence.excerpt: مَّا خَلۡقُكُمۡ وَلَا بَعۡثُكُمۡ إِلَّا كَنَفۡسٖ وَٰحِدَةٍۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعُۢ بَصِيرٌ

candidates.label: Trees-as-pens sea-as-ink metaphor establishing infinite divine speech
candidates.definition: In 31:27: If trees on earth were pens and sea ink with seven more added words of Allah would not be exhausted.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَوۡ أَنَّمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مِن شَجَرَةٍ أَقۡلَٰمٞ وَٱلۡبَحۡرُ يَمُدُّهُۥ مِنۢ بَعۡدِهِۦ سَبۡعَةُ أَبۡحُرٖ مَّا نَفِدَتۡ كَلِمَٰتُ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٞ

candidates.label: Closing hamd with sign-recognition and divine awareness affirmation
candidates.definition: In 31:34: Say praise to Allah; He will show you His signs and you will recognize them; Lord not unaware.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡغَيۡثَ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِۖ وَمَا تَدۡرِي نَفۡسٞ مَّاذَا تَكۡسِبُ غَدٗاۖ وَمَا تَدۡرِي نَفۡسُۢ بِأَيِّ أَرۡضٖ تَمُوتُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرُۢ

candidates.label: Knowledge of Hour exclusively divine negating human prediction
candidates.definition: In 31:34: Knowledge of Hour is only with Allah; none reveals its time except Him.

evidence.excerpt: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَيُنَزِّلُ ٱلۡغَيۡثَ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡحَامِۖ وَمَا تَدۡرِي نَفۡسٞ مَّاذَا تَكۡسِبُ غَدٗاۖ وَمَا تَدۡرِي نَفۡسُۢ بِأَيِّ أَرۡضٖ تَمُوتُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرُۢ

candidates.label: Dispute without knowledge-guidance-scripture as triple epistemological deficit
candidates.definition: In 31:20: People dispute about Allah without knowledge without guidance without enlightening book.

evidence.excerpt: أَلَمۡ تَرَوۡاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَأَسۡبَغَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ نِعَمَهُۥ ظَٰهِرَةٗ وَبَاطِنَةٗۗ وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ مَن يُجَٰدِلُ فِي ٱللَّهِ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٖ وَلَا هُدٗى وَلَا كِتَٰبٖ مُّنِيرٖ
